INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]
(DEPENDENCY_ID, TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))+ (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(DEPENDENCY_ID),0) FROM [OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY]) , 'TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE' TASK_NAME,'TSK_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE' DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME


------TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE
INSERT INTO [OM].[OM_TASKS]
(
	[TASK_NAME]	,
	[DATA_LAYER]	,
	[SCHEMA_NAME]	,
	[TABLE_NAME]	,
	[SOURCE_CODE]	,
	[DESCRIPTION]	,
	[UPDATE_DATETIME]	,
	[CREATE_DATETIME]	,
	[MONTHEND],
	[FREQUENCY_LOADING],
	[TABLE_TYPE]
)
SELECT 
	'TSK_STG_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE' TASK_NAME,
	'EDS_STG' DATA_LAYER,
	'D360' SCHEMA_NAME,
	'STG_EDS_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE' TABLE_NAME,
	'DEP' SOURCE_CODE,
	NULL DESCRIPTION,
	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) UPDATE_DATETIME,
	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) CREATE_DATETIME	,
	NULL [MONTHEND],
	'WEEKDAYS' [FREQUENCY_LOADING],
	'SNAPSHOT' [TABLE_TYPE]
